verdict.rationale: Salesforce offers a self-serve free trial signup (salesforce-docs-15), but community evidence directly contradicts the idea of fast, partner-free setup: users describe needing 'an army of salesforce consultants' and heavy customization work, and compare its complexity to Jira (salesforce-comm-4, salesforce-comm-6, salesforce-comm-8). No evidence supports a sub-hour real-data pipeline setup without implementation help.
